etsy.title: Chunky Beanie Crochet Pattern PDF, Adult Ribbed Hat S M L, Easy Quick Gift, Top Down Half Double Crochet, English German
etsy.description:
A warm, stretchy beanie you can finish in an evening: worked top down in half double crochet with a ribbed post-stitch brim. Three adult sizes in one pattern. About 2 hours.

• Skill level: easy+ (3/6), you need hdc, increases and post stitches (explained)
• Sizes: S head 50–53 cm, M 54–57 cm, L 58–61 cm; about 21–23 cm tall
• Hook: 8 mm; gauge 9 hdc = 10 cm
• Yarn: chunky / bulky (#5), about 100–130 g
• Tip for a longer slouchy beanie included

WAYS TO USE IT: Christmas gifts, craft fair stock, matching family hats.

PDF PATTERN ONLY – not the finished item. Instant download in English (US terms + UK table) and German (Deutsch).
Includes a stitch chart (symbol diagram), a finished-shape sketch with measurements and a symbol key.
New pattern: the first image is the stitch chart; a maker-tested photo will be added.
For personal use and small-batch handmade sales with credit to AureliaVenn. Please don't share or resell the pattern.

Written with the help of AI tools; stitch counts checked round by round.
